up: Retrieve IC50 activity values (in nM) for compounds tested against the human target FLT3 (Fms-related tyrosine kinase 3). For each matching activity record, return the following details: compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, standard activity value, standard units, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, target ChEMBL ID, target preferred name, and target organism.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.pref_name = 'Fms-related tyrosine kinase 3'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM';
